easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Lagrella until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
